# gpupaas_bare_metal_instance (Data Source)

Look up a first-class bare-metal machine by name within a project, optionally scoped to a workspace. The password and the cloud-init script are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_bare_metal_instance" "demo" {
  project   = "system-catalog"
  workspace = "team-a"
  name      = "demo-machine"
}

output "phase" {
  value = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_instance.demo.status.phase
}

output "private_ip" {
  value = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_instance.demo.status.private_ip
}
```
